channel.title: SnowScope · Snow reports
channel.description: Daily snow reports for skiers: where the snow is, what is coming and where to ski, from the SnowScope snow map and measuring stations. Every number comes from that day's data.

item.title: Italy's snow cover jumped 11,110 km² in seven days
item.description: Italy gained significant snow cover in a week, with the Aosta Valley receiving 176 cm in 72 hours. SnowScope shows 30,400 km² white on 24 November.

item.title: Rosa Khutor snow by month: 34 winters from 938 m to 2453 m
item.description: Rosa Khutor above Krasnaya Polyana: usual snow by month at the base, mid-mountain and top over 34 winters, the December gamble and the trend.

item.title: Finland vs Sweden ski snow: 46 winters at Levi, Ylläs, Åre, Hemavan
item.description: Finnish Lapland against the Swedish mountains: usual snow by month at eight resorts over 46 winters, who is losing snow and where it lies now.

item.title: Dolomites snow by month: Cortina, Val Gardena and Alta Badia compared
item.description: How snow depth changes month by month at three top Dolomites resorts across 46 past winters, from base to summit.

item.title: Telluride ski report: 51 in on the upper slopes (US West, 23 November)
item.description: Telluride has 51 in (130 cm) on upper slopes today. Brian Head Resort leads the US West with 57 in (144 cm), but Telluride's recent gains matter more for skiers planning the week ahead.

item.title: Switzerland: Glacier 3000 leads with 76 cm, well above normal for late November
item.description: Switzerland has 76 cm at Glacier 3000 on 23 November, more snow than in nine winters out of ten. The Bernese Oberland and Valais Alps received up to 144 cm in three days.

item.title: Where to find up to 29 cm of fresh snow in the next three days: Switzerland
item.description: Snow in Switzerland on 23 November: snow depth on the upper slopes, fresh snow, the next three days and the pick for a short trip.

item.title: Bavaria and the Black Forest snow today: Zugspitze leads with 63 cm (23 November)
item.description: Snow in Bavaria and the Black Forest on 23 November: snow depth on the upper slopes, fresh snow, the next three days and the pick for a short trip.

item.title: Prà Alpesina snow forecast: 57 cm expected by 26 November (Alps)
item.description: Prà Alpesina will see 57 cm of new snow by 26 November. Forecast data from 23 November shows heaviest falls on 25 November as freezing level rises.

item.title: La Pierre Saint-Martin snow forecast: up to 42 cm expected by 26 November (Pyrenees)
item.description: La Pierre Saint-Martin snow forecast: up to 42 cm expected by 26 November (Pyrenees). At Astun, the freezing level reaches 1,960 m to 3,170 m on 24 …

item.title: Alpe d'Huez Grand Domaine fresh snow report: 106 cm in 72 hours (Alps, 23 November)
item.description: Alpe d'Huez got 106 cm of fresh snow in 72 hours by 23 November. More powder coming, but watch for rain mid-week.

item.title: Snow depths in the Alps in December: where the most snow usually lies, from 46 winters
item.description: Twelve famous Alpine resorts ranked by their usual December snow depth at mid-mountain and the top, from 46 past winters, with the poor-December floor for each and the weeks that never fail.

item.title: Saddleback Mountain 20 cm: freezing level climbs above the peaks
item.description: Rain threatens upper slopes at Saddleback Mountain where 20 cm sits at 1,218 m. Freezing level rises to 3,760 m today, 22 November.

item.title: US West snow this season vs last season: Mount Rose Ski Tahoe 38 in against 9 in (22 November)
item.description: Mount Rose Ski Tahoe has 38 in (97 cm) on 22 November, more than four times last year's 9 in (23 cm). All four major resorts tracked show gains.

item.title: Western Canada snowpack check: Whistler Blackcomb holds the deepest cover, 153 cm (22 November)
item.description: Whistler Blackcomb leads Western Canada with 153 cm on upper slopes. Snow covers 398,620 km² across 52 of 57 resorts on 22 November.

item.title: Whistler Blackcomb 101 cm incoming: how three days reshape Western Canada snow
item.description: Whistler Blackcomb will receive 101 cm of new snow by November 25, far exceeding early-season norms. Mount Cain Alpine Park leads the region with 132 cm forecast.

item.title: Will Bulgaria get snow this week? Yes—up to 25 cm by next Saturday
item.description: Bulgaria's mountains face significant snowfall in the next 7 days, with a peak of 10 cm on 28 November. Snow depth today is 1–9 cm at ski resorts; the Rila Mountains lead with 7 cm in 72 hours.

item.title: Platak versus Sella Nevea: Croatia trails Slovenia in early-season snow
item.description: Croatia has 3 cm at Platak on 22 November; Slovenia's Sella Nevea holds 42 cm. Both countries face a thaw before the week's main snow event.

item.title: Hungary vs Slovakia: 0 % white against 13 %
item.description: Hungary has no snow cover on 22 November, while Slovakia shows 13 %. The week ahead brings up to 8 cm, with the best chance on 26 November.

item.title: Romania: snow line sits at 1,200 m, peaks white but valleys still green
item.description: Snow covers 25% of Romania today as the winter season begins. The snow line is at 1,200 m, with 99% cover above 2,000 m. Data from 22 November 2026.

item.title: Wildcat Mountain 56 cm in two weeks, mostly in week one
item.description: Wildcat Mountain forecast to gain 56 cm over 14 days. Week one (23–29 Nov) brings 29 cm, with 22 cm falling on 27 November. Data from 22 November.

item.title: Hurricane Ridge snow forecast: 5–24 in expected by 25 November (US West)
item.description: Mixed rain and snow at Hurricane Ridge through 25 November. Up to 24 in (61 cm) forecast near the top; rain falls below 4,528 ft (1,380 m). Data from 22 November.

item.title: Jackson Hole snow base: 11 in of new snow in three days (US West, 22 November)
item.description: Jackson Hole received 11 in (28 cm) of fresh snow in 72 hours. SnowScope shows 186 resorts with snow across the US West on 22 November.

item.title: Western Canada snow outlook: Mount Washington leads with 359 cm in 14 days
item.description: Mount Washington Alpine Resort forecast to receive 359 cm of new snow in the next 14 days, with the heaviest falls in week one. Data from 22 November 2026.

item.title: 42 Slovak resorts have snow on upper slopes
item.description: 42 of 107 resorts in Slovakia show snow cover today. Vysoké Tatry leads with 33 cm at the summit as the season builds.

item.title: Will Sweden get more snow in the next two weeks? First 2 cm, then 12 cm
item.description: Sweden's snow cover stands at 314,500 km² on 22 November. SnowScope shows 2 cm in week one, then 12 cm in week two, with mountain peaks already holding 66 cm.

item.title: Kosovo snow forecast: 65 cm possible in the next week
item.description: Kosovo's mountains face major snowfall ahead. SnowScope shows up to 65 cm in the next 7 days, with 19 cm expected on 28 November. Data from 22 November.

item.title: North Macedonia braces for significant snowfall: 47 cm possible over seven days
item.description: A major snow event is forecast for North Macedonia over the next week, with up to 47 cm expected by 2026-11-29. The heaviest falls arrive tomorrow.

item.title: Norway is right on schedule: Riksgränsen has 54 cm, a normal 22 November has 63 cm
item.description: Riksgränsen holds 54 cm on 22 November, tracking closely with the 63 cm typical for this date. Snow covers 94% of Norway's mountains.

item.title: Pyrenees snow depth: 24 cm at Cauterets, more arriving by week-end
item.description: Cauterets Cirque du Lys leads the Pyrenees with 24 cm at the top on 22 November. Heavy snow forecast for 25 November will push coverage from 44 to 51 resorts.

item.title: Poland: white above 1,000 m, green below
item.description: Poland has 1,080 km² of snow on 22 November. Above 1,000 m almost all slopes are white; below, they are mostly bare.

item.title: La Grave 171 cm: Alps ahead after slow start
item.description: La Grave has 171 cm on upper slopes today, which is 68% of normal for late November. The Alps saw sharp gains this weekend.

item.title: Julian Alps lead Slovenia's snow: 40 cm in three days
item.description: Slovenia's mountains gained 1880 km² of snow cover in three days. The Julian Alps saw the most fall, with 40 cm, while lower ranges stayed dry.

item.title: Where does rain turn to snow in the Pyrenees this week?
item.description: The 0 °C level rises to 3200 m on Tuesday, bringing rain to mid-mountain slopes. Snow line stays above base at most resorts until Wednesday.

item.title: When to book in Finland: Kallin has 11 cm now, best snow usually in early March / mid-March
item.description: Kallin holds 11 cm at 40 m on 22 November, nearly double its normal depth. Best snow arrives in weeks 9–11 (early to mid-March).

item.title: Where did the 16 cm fall in Ukraine? Fresh snow by mountain range
item.description: 72-hour snowfall mapped across Ukrainian ranges: Chornohora led with 24 cm, Gorgany 19 cm, Borzhava 14 cm. Data from 2026-11-22.

item.title: Alps two-week outlook: 95 cm peak, heaviest snow in week one
item.description: The Alps will collect up to 95 cm of new snow in the next 14 days, with 63% arriving in the first week. Best conditions above 1500 m from November 23. Data from November 22.

item.title: Germany gains 5,270 km² of snow cover in seven days
item.description: German snow cover jumped from 5,460 to 10,730 km² in a week. The Allgäu Alps lead with 47 cm of fresh snow in 72 hours as of 22 November.

item.title: How much snow is coming in the Alps? Up to 64 cm at Jungfraujoch Snow Fun Park by 25 November
item.description: By 25 November, 64 cm of new snow forecast at Jungfraujoch Snow Fun Park. Data from 22 November.

item.title: Austria's snow cover jumped by 11,600 km² in one week
item.description: Austria gained 11,600 km² of snow in seven days. Stubaier Gletscher leads with 67 cm. Data from 22 November 2026.

item.title: Sauerland and the German uplands snow today: Feldberg leads with 18 cm (22 November)
item.description: Snow in Sauerland and the German uplands on 22 November: snow depth on the upper slopes, fresh snow, the next three days and the pick for a short trip.

item.title: Switzerland 71 percent white, France 18 percent: the Alpine divide on 22 November
item.description: Swiss Alps covered 71 percent white versus 18 percent in France as of 22 November. Valais holds 166 cm in 72 hours.

item.title: Where to find up to 17 cm of fresh snow in the next three days: Tyrol and Vorarlberg
item.description: Snow in Tyrol and Vorarlberg on 22 November: snow depth on the upper slopes, fresh snow, the next three days and the pick for a short trip.

item.title: French Alps running early: La Grave at 171 cm, well above average for November
item.description: La Grave has 171 cm of snow, far ahead of the typical 82 cm for late November. France's Alps gained 90 cm in 72 hours as of 22 November.

item.title: Port del Comte: the ski area closest to Barcelona, and what the snow is really like
item.description: Port del Comte sits 1744–2122 m above Solsona: natural snow depth peaks at 26–40 cm across the mountain, mostly in January and February. Data from 46 past winters.

item.title: Mölltaler Gletscher: Carinthia's glacier skiing, snow by month and the long season
item.description: The Mölltal glacier above Flattach: usual snow depth at the base, mid-mountain and the top from 46 past winters, from the first snow in September to the May skiing, and why the depth is a different world from the valley.

item.title: Tignes snow conditions by month: the glacier, Val Claret and Tignes-le-Lac compared
item.description: Tignes climbs from 1559 m to 3447 m across 46 past winters. Base: 117 cm peak. Mid-mountain: 216 cm. Glacier: 372 cm. Data from November 2026.

item.title: Hafjell snow by month: when Norway's family mountain is at its best
item.description: Hafjell above Lillehammer month by month: usual snow depth at the base, mid-mountain and the top from 46 past winters, the first snow, the deepest weeks and how the recent winters compare.

item.title: Kvitfjell snow depth by month: the World Cup hill's winter in numbers
item.description: Kvitfjell's 46-winter snow record: when to expect deep snow for the speed races and spring skiing on Norway's Olympic downhill course.

item.title: Trysil snow report explained: top against bottom through the winter
item.description: Why Trysil's snow report shows two very different numbers: usual depth at the base, mid-mountain and the top of Trysilfjellet from 46 past winters, month by month, and what it means for the runs you will ski.
